answer.rationale: Roll out in-product activation messaging: it is the only recovered experiment with confirmed gains in activation (+6%), week-one engagement (+11%), and 30-day retention (+1%), supporting sustainable qualified revenue without the known retention downside of discounting. Promotional pricing is not selected because the recovered SMB discount experiment showed 30-day retention down 12% and explicitly warned against treating it as sustainable growth. This may not fully neutralize competitor-driven price churn, which cannot be verified further this cycle.
